meta.name: x-kev
meta.description:
CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog.
List actively exploited vulnerabilities prioritized by CISA.

**Dependency**: This is an x-cmd module. Install x-cmd first (see x-cmd skill for installation options).
see x-cmd skill for installation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询CISA已知被利用漏洞目录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速获取CISA优先处理的活跃利用漏洞列表
copy.tagline_en: Query CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to CISA's prioritized list of actively exploited vulnerabilities

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询 CISA 已知被利用漏洞（KEV）目录，列出所有或前 N 个活跃漏洞。
howto.when: 当用户要求查询 CISA KEV 漏洞列表，或指定数量（如前 100 个）时触发。

say.text: 列出所有 CISA KEV 漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会执行 x kev ls 命令并返回结果。

say.text: 显示前 50 个已知被利用漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会执行 x kev top 50 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, listing all or the top N actively exploited vulnerabilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to list CISA KEV vulnerabilities or specifies a number (e.g., top 100).

say_en.note: Claude will run x kev ls and return the result.
Claude will run x kev top 50.
